page: UpCloud GPU-16xCPU-192GB-3xL4 is a GPU-accelerated server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 16 vCPUs configured with a shared CPU allocation. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 12.0 GB per vCPU.

The primary hardware accelerator configuration consists of three NVIDIA L4 GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing a combined total of 72 GB of VRAM. This server does not include local storage, meaning storage resources must be attached externally. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

The shared CPU allocation represents a potential performance tradeoff for workloads requiring sustained, non-burstable host CPU execution. However, the dense allocation of three NVIDIA L4 GPUs and 192.0 GB of RAM makes this hardware profile qualitatively cost-efficient for GPU-heavy tasks that do not bottleneck on dedicated host CPU cores. Suitable workloads include machine learning inference, data science jobs, and GPU-accelerated rendering or video processing.
